## Your monthly payment

You would pay **$178.21** each month. Over five years you pay about **$1,692.65** in interest.

The payment comes from the annuity formula, where $P = 9000$, $r = 0.07/12$ and $n = 60$:

$$M = \frac{P r}{1 - (1+r)^{-n}} = 178.21$$

| Month | Payment | Interest | Balance |
|------:|--------:|---------:|--------:|
| 1 | $178.21 | $52.50 | $8,874.29 |
| 2 | $178.21 | $51.77 | $8,747.85 |
| 60 | $178.25 | $1.03 | $0.00 |

If you can set aside this much each month, the loan is affordable for you.
